long_biography.plain_text:
The Bag Hub gave Ling Ling King a business role in the circular luxury market. She supplied and consigned merchandise during the reseller’s early days, then became a partner whose contribution extends to product selection and strategic direction. The company has not disclosed her percentage interest or the financial scale of the holding.

Beyond retail, King has supported educational and disability-focused causes; she previously served as a trustee of Philippine Cerebral Palsy Inc. She was married to Archimedes “Archie” King, whose hospitality companies grew from a business established by his family. That marriage explains her association with the King name but does not, by itself, assign her the hotels or related trusts. Without evidence of a transfer or a larger personally held asset, the source and principal sector of her wealth remain undetermined.
